newsitem.title: UK: UK shares nudge lower in early trading.
newsitem.headline: UK shares nudge lower in early trading.

text.p: UK stocks moved lower at the start of trading on Thursday, taking their lead from a decline on Wall Street, though dealers said the UK market may find support after closing lower for the past six sessions.

The FTSE 100 index was down 16.2 points at 4,540.9 by 0744 GMT, with decliners outweighing gainers by some five-to-one. Boots fell as the stock went ex a special dividend and profit-taking continued to weigh on banks.
"It is all looking a bit nasty at the moment," said one dealer. "The big players are on the sidelines keeping their powder dry and there are one or two lines of stock on offer."
